title: One season of meets (and their results)
description: src/assets/meets/meets-YYYY-YYYY.json. The build checks this file and fills in full school and pool names from schools.json and pools.json.

updated.description: When the schedule last changed, like "2026-10-25". Shown as "Last updated" on the Meet Schedule page.

meets.description: One entry per meet, in any order (the site sorts them by date).

type.description: The kind of meet. Anything with "Championship" in it counts as postseason.

opponents.description: School codes from schools.json, like ["BDHS", "SHS"]. For a championship, the meet's field, like ["Northwestern District"].

homeAway.description: Home, Away, or Neutral (championships are usually Neutral).

host.description: The host school's short name, like "Brentsville". Can be left out for home meets (it becomes "Kettle Run").

pool.description: A pool code from pools.json, like "WARF" or "PWAC".

status.description: Leave out for a normal meet.

statusNote.description: Why, shown with the status — like "Weather".

results.description: Add after the meet. Dual meets: scores. Championships: place (and optional standings).

pdf.description: Link to the full results PDF, or "".

scores.description: Dual meets: one score per opponent.

vs.description: The opponent's code, same as in "opponents".

place.description: Championships: Kettle Run's team place, like 6.

standings.description: Championships (optional): every team in finishing order, like ["Goochland", "Meridian", …].
